limits: Muscat Blanc and Muscat D'Alexandrie together: at most 5%

blurb.text: A Roussillon appellation within Languedoc-Roussillon, making red, rosé and a few white wines. Reds come from Grenache Noir, Mourvèdre, Syrah, Carignan and Cinsault, and whites from Grenache Blanc and Gris. Its boundaries match Banyuls, whose grapes go into fortified wines.
